definitions.role: worker entry index-2 string; corpus contains exactly 'PLANTER' and 'COLLECTOR', so planters+collectors = workers at every step
definitions.groups: target_win/loss = the parsed target in its wins/losses; opp_win = opponents in games the target won; opp_loss = opponents in games the target lost
definitions.series: per-step values from the single observation event of each step (300 steps/game, no missing steps in these corpora)
definitions.planter_share: per-step planters/(planters+collectors), averaged over steps with at least one worker
